scripts.dev: bun run build:web && bun run --filter @app/api dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @app/web build && bun run --filter @app/api build
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @app/api check && bun run --filter @app/web check
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run deploy:inject && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env=""
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build && bun run deploy:inject:staging && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.deploy:temp: bun run build && bun run deploy:inject && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env="" --temporary
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c apps/api/wrangler.toml
